overview: This 267-page file documents the restoration of patent, utility model, and design rights in occupied Japan, chiefly from 1948 to 1949. State Department, SCAP, and Far Eastern Commission records trace Allied policy debates, Japanese implementing measures, foreign owners’ claims and royalties, and efforts to let Japanese inventors seek patents abroad.
interest: Policy drafts, occupation directives, and company claims show how postwar patent rights were negotiated and put into practice.
